title: Top-k expert routing of router logits in one kernel, a warp per token row: softmax or sigmoid scores, correction bias, renormalization, NaN-safe ties to the lower id

warp-rows.what: a warp per token row: each lane holds experts lane, lane + 32, ...; scores, the selection by repeated warp argmax and the weights in registers

ROWS.what: token rows a warp takes, one after another
